page_title: VEN 0-1 BOL | Venezia v Bologna 29/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A yellow card for a tackle by Jay Idzes (Venezia). Marco Di Bello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+1' Bologna will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' It is time for a substitution. Alfred Duncan (Venezia) is on for Gianluca Busio.
89' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Bologna.

86' Estanis Pedrola (Bologna) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
85' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
82' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replaces Thijs Dallinga.
82' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini makes his way off the pitch and Estanis Pedrola (Bologna) comes on as his replacement.
81' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

80' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee blows his whistle, Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
80' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
79' The free kick from long range is taken Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna). His effort towards the right post ends up in the goalkeeper’s hands.
79' Bologna are awarded a free kick from long range.
78' Marco Di Bello shows the yellow card to Cheick Conde (Venezia) for a heavy challenge.
75' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
74' Here is a change. Davide Calabria is going off and Vincenzo Italiano gives the last tactical orders to Emil Holm (Bologna).
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Tommaso Pobega (Bologna) coming on for Remo Freuler.
73' The corner is swung in but Venezia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.

73' John Yeboah (Venezia) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Lukasz Skorupski, who makes a comfortable save. Venezia have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
72' Daniel Fila goes off the pitch and Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) comes on.
72' Poor challenge! Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is penalised for tripping and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle.

70' What a big chance! Gianluca Busio (Venezia) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Cheick Conde (Venezia) replaces Issa Doumbia.
67' A substitution has been made. Gaetano Oristanio goes off and John Yeboah (Venezia) comes on.
67' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to substitute Mikael Egill Ellertsson and he is replaced by Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolo Cambiaghi leaves the pitch and Dan Ndoye (Bologna) comes on.

66' A brilliant individual effort! Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) tricks his way past challenges into the box and drags his shot narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
64' The statistic for corner kicks – 0:2.
61' Kike Perez (Venezia) sees a yellow card from Marco Di Bello after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' Venezia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
57' Venezia couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
54' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
54' Venezia are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.

52' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
49' 0 - 1 Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and slams the ball inside the left post. What a wonderful strike!
48' The ball possession at the moment is 36:64.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Venezia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
45' The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.
42' Bologna get a corner.
41' Bologna are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.

40' Jay Idzes (Venezia) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
40' Venezia have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
39' Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

37' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bologna are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

34' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a decent low shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
33' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while in possession of the ball.
33' Sam Beukema (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
31' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
28' Marco Di Bello blows for a foul after Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
25' Davide Calabria (Bologna) has received a yellow card for his foul.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Alessio Zerbin (Venezia) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Marco Di Bello ignores the protests.
21' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

19' The cross into the penalty area from Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
16' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Nicolo Casale (Bologna). Venezia win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
13' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Ionut Radu easily deals with the threat.
12' Remo Freuler (Bologna) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
10' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) sends a chip pass into the box, but Ionut Radu is quickest to intercept the ball.

9' A cross by Juan Miranda (Bologna) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
6' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Juan Miranda (Bologna) commits a foul after dangerous play.
3' The game is interrupted. Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Bologna will kick the game off.
Marco Di Bello is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
